metric_limit: Standard sensitivity/specificity/PPV/NPV/accuracy are suppressed because 95/500 cases were abstain or nondiagnostic under the pre-reveal rule.
interpretation: Engineering image baseline only; not ChatGPT clinical accuracy and not clinical validation.
All 3 reference-positive AFIB cases received a positive baseline prediction, but 43 reference-negative cases also received positive predictions.
The very low event count (3 positives) and 19% unresolved rate preclude stable clinical performance claims.
Do not tune thresholds on this revealed cohort and do not promote any clinical module to green from this result.
